scripts.supabase:types: supabase gen types typescript --project-id $NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID --schema public > src/types/supabase.ts

_notes.no-framer-motion: Splash + parallax use plain CSS keyframes and a small useScrollParallax hook. No animation library needed.
_notes.no-styled-components: Tailwind only. Per Tom's stack standard.
_notes.no-prisma-no-drizzle: Supabase client is sufficient. RLS enforces auth at DB level.
_notes.lucide-only-for-icons: Don't add icon kits. Lucide covers all needs.
